description: APPROVAL-GATED. Save the owner-approved phone number (SMS) or email address where KaiCalls sends the owner the result of their first test call, for the exact active activation session. Once that test call's record is ready, KaiCalls sends a real text or email to that destination through its messaging provider; saving the destination alone is not proof anything was delivered. Replaces any destination saved earlier for the session.
name: confirm_notification_destination
title: Confirm Activation Notification Destination
